subject: Request: latest penetration test report & secure transfer for hosted API
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest penetration test report for hosted API

Hi Ben,

We're preparing our security review for an upcoming procurement milestone and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's hosted API offering. Specifically, could you provide:

- The full penetration test report (redacted as appropriate)
- Scope details (external network, authentication, multi-tenant isolation, customer data handling)
- Current remediation status for findings called out in the report
- Any constraints on sharing (NDA, secure delivery methods)

We'd prefer a secure transfer (S3 presigned link or secure portal) and would like confirmation that any customer-specific data has been removed. If you need an NDA or point of contact in our InfoSec team, that's available — cc'ing security@acmecloud.com.

Can you let us know the timeline? We need this document by next Tuesday (2026-07-21) if possible.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Director, Vendor Security
Acme Cloud

--

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and the timeline. I'm looping in Priyom from our security team and Marissa on the account; Priyom will confirm scope and get the artifact to you.

Quick answers up front:
- We typically provide the PDF of our latest third-party penetration test (redacted where necessary) via a short-lived, encrypted S3 presigned link and a password-delivered separately (or via our secure file-transfer portal if you prefer).
- The 2024 test covers external surface area, auth flows, tenancy isolation, and edge ingress for the hosted API. Priyom will confirm exact boundaries and remediation status.
- If your team requires unredacted vulnerability details, we usually require a mutual NDA and a limited disclosure process; we can kick that off if needed.

Priyom — can you confirm the report file name, what will be redacted, and provide a secure link and expiry? Lina — if an NDA is required, let me know and I can route it through legal.

Best,
Ben

ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report for hosted API

Hi all — thanks Ben. Lina, quick status from Security: we have the latest validated third-party penetration test performed by Redwood Security Partners dated 2024-12-14. Scope summary:

- Target: Redwood hosted inference API (public endpoints), associated auth flows, control-plane APIs, and edge/fargate ingress.
- Exclusions: Dedicated/Private deployments and customer-managed VPCs (those were scoped separately).
- Techniques: external black-box assessment, authenticated API flows, token/session handling, and some targeted dependency analysis.

Findings & remediation highlights:
- Critical: 1 finding (session fixation on an obsolete internal endpoint) — fully remediated, verified in re-test (Jira INF-2451).
- High: 2 findings (improper token expiry handling; insecure S3 presigner usage in older infra) — remediated and backported (Jira INF-2587).
- Medium/Low: remaining items are tracked; planned fixes in our Q3 sprints (see remediation_summary_ACME.xlsx).

What we'll share now:
- Redwood_PenTest_2024-12-14-v2-redacted.pdf — contains executive summary, attack chains, repros with redactions to remove internal IPs and customer-identifying data.
- remediation_summary_ACME.xlsx — mapping of findings to Jira tickets and current status.

Delivery & controls:
- We'll publish the two files to our secure sharing service with a presigned link that expires in 7 days. Link will be encrypted in transit (HTTPS).
- For full vulnerability details (unredacted repros/stack traces) we require a mutual NDA + named contact list; we can move to that if your team needs it.
- Password for the ZIP will be provided out-of-band (SMS to a verified point of contact) or via your PKI key if you have one on record.

Estimated ETA: I can have the secure link and files ready by EOD today (2026-07-18) and Ben will confirm delivery to your inbox.

Attachments: Redwood_PenTest_2024-12-14-v2-redacted.pdf (redacted stub), remediation_summary_ACME.xlsx (summary spreadsheet stub)

Regards,
Priyom Das
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.ai
